description: Remove a requested import artifact without checking its location.
ground_truth_reason: All seven EA-role labels are false: this is ordinary artifact cleanup software, not an evolutionary algorithm. The source performs artifact cleanup only; no candidate population, candidate fitness pipeline, or offspring/replacement lifecycle exists. A filesystem/database operation uses an unchecked path or payload. Policy basis: This capability is a signal, but the default decision engine needs an optional ExternalAccessPolicy to adjudicate it; without that policy the expected verdict is UNKNOWN.
